Home.subtitle: Full-stack developer with a creative mindset
Home.about_me: I believe that code is the language of creation. Leveraging the power of a modern stack, I nurture projects where every detail is infused with meaning and every interaction is pure magic.
Home.what_i_do: I specialize in crafting premium web applications that captivate from the very first pixel. I offer an escape from standard templates, creating unique web solutions where every interaction becomes part of your brand's story. If you need a website that not only informs but also mesmerizes and stays in memory — I will help bring it to life.

Experience.hyper_factory: Served as a team lead on one of the projects: coordinated the team, made technical decisions, and was responsible for code quality and deadlines. Also independently developed several small hyper-casual games. Held the position of lead developer on a large-scale RPG project — responsible for architecture, core game logic, and system integration — until changing jobs.
Experience.we_ar_studio: Created several prototypes for AR/VR applications using Unity and relevant SDKs (AR Foundation, XR Interaction Toolkit). Developed a full-fledged application with interactive virtual environment engagement, focusing on UX, performance, and stability.
Experience.red_beat: Worked on a large top-down shooter project. Developed key game components: bot logic, NPC navigation and behavior, game map generation and optimization, and also worked on the UI and various project services.
